decisions.reasoning: MediaDive 2060 and the Wako catalog support unqualified Hipolypepton as the Nihon casein-digest product, distinct from soybean S/N/NS variants. Retain that identity without selecting a Trypticase alternative or equating generic Polypeptone. Supplement: the Polypeptone owner fragment retains all original Hipolypepton exclusions and now withdraws the two unsupported globally resolving Nihon Polypepton aliases as provenance-only source labels. Historical primary sources support a casein-derived Nihon product family, not pure final casein or an exact recipe-vintage/SKU bridge; current JCM181 names Hipolypepton (FUJIFILM Wako), so older Nihon labels cannot be globally reconciled by a renamed recipe alone. MediaDive442 still provides no supplier. POLYPEPTONE-001 final grounding is OPEN: the supported FOODON broader relation and the MICRO0000179 exact BD-blend candidate require coordinator selection of the coupled owner/product scope. Feasible source-supported BD curation may proceed separately while ambiguous routes remain held. No assigned case, raw label, occurrence, quantity, source hold or owner/release admission is changed by this supplement.
